main_text.p: 3. οἱ νεώτεροι τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἀεὶ εἰσι τολμη- ρότεροι.
[Observatio I. Pro Genitivo partitionis, nonnunquam ponitur casus ipsarum partium, ut:
οἱ ἄνθρωποι οἱ μὲν ἀγαθοὶ, οἱ δ' πονηροί.
τὰς φίλας τὰς μὲν ἀπέκτεινε, τὰς δ' πόνη- τας ἀπέδλεξε.
2. Genitivi Superlativorum exponuntur etiam aliis casibus, praecedente Praepositione, ut:
ἐγὼ ἐξ ἁπάσων ἡ καλλίστη ἐδλοξα.
2. Superlativus nonnunquam antecedeti Substantivo; nonnunquam Genitivo plurali, in Genere consentit. ut:
κτημάτων παντῶν ἐςἰ ἰμιώτατον αἰὴρ φί- λος.

page.notes: Greek text is partly unclear in the scan; several Greek words are transcribed as best read. The marginal mark "III." is in the right margin. Printed marks such as the reference sign at the end of several Greek lines are reproduced only approximately.
